_notes: Pre-action check settings. Demo values, not official AICTE rules. Rule-based: no AI.
duplicate_days: a similar request or notice from another bureau within this many days is a DUPLICATE EFFORT.
conflict_days: another bureau's show-cause notice or escalation within this many days makes closing a CONFLICTING ACTION.
idle_days: both linked cases with no activity for this many days means WAITING ON EACH OTHER.
